title: Jannini asks the court to let them exhume Chereze to study the bacteria

tellings.quote: after 30 yearsini is suggesting and requesting authorization from the court.

plain: Varginha is a town in Brazil, and a man named Ahmed Foratu, interviewed on a podcast about a hospital that is said to have operated on an alien, says a doctor named Janini is now, about 30 years later, asking a court for permission to dig up the body of a person named Chereze. According to Foratu, the aim is to study bacteria in the remains, which, if the story holds, could show what Chereze was exposed to.
